section_summary.extract_value: The section reports that ethnic identity (MEIM) was positively associated with body appreciation (BAS) and positively related to self-esteem and appearance evaluation; MEIM had small negative associations with Western ideal internalization and eating/shape/weight concerns and was not related to eating disorder behaviors. Mediation analyses using 5,000 bootstrapped resamples indicated Western beauty ideal internalization (SATAQ-3 Internalization-General) mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating concern, shape concern, and weight concern, but not the relation between ethnic identity and body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source: "As hypothesized, ethnic identity, as measured by the MEIM, was positively  associated with body appreciation (BAS); women with higher ethnic identification also reported greater body appreciation." "Based on 95% confidence intervals for the indirect effects, Western beauty ideal internalization mediated  the relation between ethnic identity and eating concern (−.35, −.01), ethnic  identity and shape concern (−.56, −.01), and ethnic identity and weight concern (−.60, −.02). No mediating relation was found for ethnic identity and  body appreciation (−.01, .24)."

section_summary.extract_value: This section reports that ethnic identity (MEIM) was positively associated with body appreciation (BAS) and showed moderate positive relations with self-esteem and small negative associations with eating concern, shape concern, and weight concern. Bootstrap mediation analyses (5,000 resamples; Table 4) indicated Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating, shape, and weight concerns but did not mediate the relation between ethnic identity and body appreciation.
section_summary.evidence_source: As hypothesized, ethnic identity, as measured by the MEIM, was positively associated with body appreciation (BAS); women with higher ethnic identification also reported greater body appreciation. Based on 95% confidence intervals for the indirect effects, Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating concern (−.35, −.01), ethnic identity and shape concern (−.56, −.01), and ethnic identity and weight concern (−.60, −.02).
